Mishrilal vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of ... on 12 
November, 2024 
Author: Alok Mathur
Bench: Alok Mathur
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:74577
Court No. - 6
Case :- Writ - A No. - 10415 of 2024
Petitioner :- Mishrilal 
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of Food Safety And Drug Admi. Lko A
Counsel for Petitioner :- Ganesh Kumar Gupta,Rajesh Pratap Singh 
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Alok Mathur,J.
1. Heard Sri Ganesh Kumar Gupta, learned counsel for petitioner as well as learned Standing Counsel for respondents.
2. By means of present writ petition, the petitioner has challenged the order of transfer dated 30.06.2024 passed by Additional Commissioner (Administration), Food Safety and Drug Administration, Govt of U.P., Lucknow thereby transferring the petitioner from the post of Food Safety Officer, Lucknow to the post of Food Safety Officer, Agra.
3. It has been submitted that the petitioner in pursuance of the said order has been relieved from the said post and he has joined on the post of Food Safety Officer, Agra on 04.10.2024. It is only after the order of transfer has been complied with as the petitioner has joined at the transferred place of posting, he has submitted an application on 09.10.2024 stating that the impugned order of transfer Mishrilal vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of ... on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192090511/
1 has been passed in violation of the guidelines issued by the State Government for the transfer session 2024-2025 and also raised certain personal grievances with regard to his family members while assailing the said order.
4. It is in the aforesaid circumstances, the petitioner in the present case, has prayed for quashing of the order of transfer dated 30.06.2024 and for directing the respondents to transfer the petitioner from Agra to Ayodhya or near any district adjacent to Ayodhya.
5. Learned Standing Counsel on the other hand has opposed the writ petition. He has submitted that petitioner was transferred by means of order dated 30.06.2024 and he has already complied with the order of transfer dated 30.06.2024. He has further submitted that once the order of transfer has been complied with without any demur and he has estopped from assailing the validity of the said order as the petitioner joined on the transferred is no longer available to assail. 
6. He further submits that the action of the petitioner itself indicates that he has accepted the order of transfer dated 30.06.2024 and he cannot be allowed to approbate and reprobate and permitted to challenge the order after his joining . 
7. After hearing learned counsel for parties and perusing the record, it is evident that the petitioner was transferred by order dated 30.06.2024. It is noticed that he never raised his grievance before any authority or forum in pursuance of his order of transfer though he has not disclosed the date but he was relieved from the post of Food Safety Officer, Lucknow but he voluntarily joined at his transferred place of posting only on 04.10.2024. It is only after joining at his transferred place of posting he had submitted his representation dated 09.10.2024.
8. Accordingly, the moment the petitioner joined at his transferred place of posting without raising any objection without demur it can be safely presumed that he has voluntarily accepted the order of transfer and he cannot be permitted to turn around and assailing the validity the the same. 
9. It is noticed that the object of an order of transfer is limited and it is not an order which is kept in operation and for beyond the purpose than it was made and once it has been complied with no longer stands open for challenge subsequently.
10. In light of the above, this Court does not find any live issue to be adjudicated. Accordingly for the aforesaid reasons, the prayer made by the petitioner for challenge the order of transfer is bereft of merits and accordingly rejected. 
11. It is also observed that in case any government official has any grievance with regard to his place of posting, he can always raise the issue before the competent authority with expedition. The competent authority is duty bound to consider the grievances of the government employees irrespective of the order of transfer and pass appropriate order thereon. The petitioner has highlighted the fact about ailment being suffered by his mother on account of which he has sought that he may be transferred at any district next to Ayodhya, this prayer can be considered by the competent authority and in case it is found suitable and there are post vacant that the petitioner can Mishrilal vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of ... on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192090511/
2 be adjusted, suitable orders can be passed in this regard. 
12. Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of with a liberty to the petitioner to prefer a fresh representation before the respondent No. 1 raising his all grievances within a period of one week from today and in case the same is moved, respondent No. 1 is directed to proceed to consider and decide the same by speaking and reasons in accordance with expeditiously, say, within a period of four weeks thereafter. 
(Alok Mathur, J.) Order Date :- 12.11.2024 Ravi/
